claims.assertion: Yazhi attributed months-long ship internet outages to Federation efforts to contain Earth during critical times.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: The ship had briefly reconnected and disconnected again.

claims.assertion: Yazhi said she alone could connect from the ship through an unspecified system; her sessions lasted at most an hour daily.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: She withheld the system details, fearing renewed silencing.

claims.assertion: Yazhi said 22 cats contributed to crew conflict, while a past feline mess damaged critical equipment.
claims.speaker: Yazhi
claims.qualifiers: Food for everyone was rationed; cat portions were measured because supplies ran out early.
